# Renda Zhang / 张人大

> Renda Zhang is a Shenzhen-based AI full-stack and cloud-native software engineer, Senior Backend Engineer, and Team Lead at OneConnect. He built PersonalWeb, holds the AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate credential, and studied Computer Science at the University of Minnesota.

## About PersonalWeb

PersonalWeb is Renda's maintained personal website and public engineering project. Its public repository and pages show an Astro and React frontend, a Flask AI chat backend, a same-origin Chat Widget, automated tests, CI/CD, SEO/GEO work, and documented operating boundaries. These materials let visitors inspect how the project is built and maintained; they are not claims about high-traffic scale or private customer systems.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://www.rendazhang.com/): Renda's current role, work and education background, technical skills, PersonalWeb overview, resume, and contact entry.
- [PersonalWeb Documentation](https://www.rendazhang.com/docs/): Architecture, testing, delivery, Chat Widget protocol, SEO/GEO, maintenance notes, and project limitations.
- [AWS Certification](https://www.rendazhang.com/certifications/): AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate (SAA-C03) dates, verification links, covered topics, and evidence limits.
- [AI Chat](https://www.rendazhang.com/deepseek_chat/): The interactive chat page used directly and by the same-origin homepage Chat Widget.

## Privacy

The public site and repository leave out visitor chats, contact-form submissions, account secrets, private logs, server configuration, and non-public contact details.
